name: jev-browse
description: Jev drives a real browser: one goal, an indexed action space, one systemOne decision per step.

scripts.compile: node scripts/build-snapshot.mjs && tsc && cp src/snapshot.js dist/snapshot.js && npm run build:bundle
scripts.build:bundle: node scripts/build-snapshot.mjs && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=bundled/cli.mjs && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=bundled/mcp.mjs && cp src/snapshot.js bundled/snapshot.js
scripts.check:bundle: npm run --silent build:bundle && git diff --exit-code -- bundled/
scripts.eval:all: node scripts/eval.mjs --file tasks.json && node scripts/eval.mjs --file tasks-hard.json && node scripts/eval.mjs --file tasks-harder.json && node scripts/eval.mjs --file tasks-hardest.json
